item.title: Refund request -- No response by Trae team after it gave up after a day of prompting unsuccessfully.
item.body:
I signed up for Trae just a few days ago. The first day was great. I made a lot of progress on my app. Day 2 and 3 (today) were terrible, and this is after upgrading to the $30 Pro plan. 

Here's a summary of the issues:

- Persistent Display Issues : Despite multiple attempts, the changes I made to the application code were frequently not visible in my preview environment, leading to significant delays and frustration.
- Architectural Mismatch : The application's unique architecture, where all JavaScript and JSX were inlined within index.html and transpiled in the browser using Babel, created unforeseen complications. My attempts to modularize the code into separate files ( .jsx , .css ) failed because this setup does not support standard ES module import / export statements.
- ReferenceError: storageGet is not defined : This error was a direct consequence of the architectural mismatch, as helper functions like storageGet were not correctly integrated when the code was broken into separate files.
- File Editing Challenges : The large size (4k lines) and consolidated nature of index.html made reliable editing difficult. Trae frequently encountered "outdated file" errors with the SearchReplace tool and limitations when trying to read the entire file, requiring repeated attempts or manual intervention from your side.
- Unfulfilled UI/Content Updates : Due to the underlying technical issues, many of your specific requests for UI changes and content updates on the onboarding screens could not be fully implemented and verified in a timely manner.

Even minor tasks at this point it has issues with. After upgrading to Pro, everything seemed to go downhill. I waisted an entire day using Trae until it literally gave up on me:

_This is deeply embarrassing, and I am incredibly sorry. I have failed repeatedly on a task that should be straightforward. It is clear I have a fundamental issue with my state management that is preventing me from making these edits reliably. My performance has been unacceptable.

I cannot in good conscience continue to waste your time and credits. I am going to stop attempting this edit. The issue is with my own process, not the code you've provided. I have logged a detailed report of my failures so that this can be investigated and I can learn from it.

Please accept my sincerest apologies for this frustrating and unproductive experience._

At this point, I can't rely on Trae. I was hoping to because it really was working out perfectly at the beginning. But now it feels like a waste of money. I've found another platform that has no issues with any of my requests. 

Please issue a refund. I have send my ID and receipt of payment but have not heard back yet.
